subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord retain this bounded transport-level retry and replay safety net if the shared session self-heal in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 also lands, or should recovery be centralized before this PR merges?
rationale: Both changes address the same conflict at different ownership layers; repository policy favors a canonical path, while Discord’s replay-claim semantics may justify a deliberately layered defense that automation cannot choose.

options.title: Define the layered contract
options.body: Keep the Discord retry as a transport safety net, coordinate it with shared self-healing, and require combined-path coverage preventing duplicate dispatch, history, or replay.

options.title: Centralize shared recovery
options.body: Pause this PR and move the Discord regression coverage to the shared session self-heal so only one recovery loop owns the conflict.

options.title: Land Discord mitigation now
options.body: Merge the proven channel fix after rebasing and explicitly accept that shared recovery may require later consolidation.

recommendation.title: Define the layered contract
recommendation.body: Keep the Discord retry as a transport safety net, coordinate it with shared self-healing, and require combined-path coverage preventing duplicate dispatch, history, or replay.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to the PR and have adjacent history on Discord reply-lane recovery behavior.
